svg.title: The agent loop
svg.desc: The agent loop as five blocks. Tag 1, Read state (blue, the orchestrator), has an arrow to tag 2, Ask the LLM (orange). An arrow goes down to tag 3, Check and run (blue), which has an arrow to the Factory block (green) on the right. Tag 3 also has an arrow left to tag 4, Record result (blue), which leads up to tag 5, Stop? (blue). From Stop?, 'no' leads up to Read state and 'yes' leads left to End. A line from the Factory runs over the top of the figure into Read state.
